newsitem.title: USA: National Health in $80 mln sales pact.
newsitem.headline: National Health in $80 mln sales pact.

text.p: National Health & Safety Corp said Monday that it has signed a contract with Comor Financial Services Inc a national marketing company, which will sell $80 million of its products over the next two years.
The company said the contract is the largest it has ever signed, and is expected to increase the company's projected revenues by almost 500 percent.
National Health & Safety provides health care and other non-insurance employee benefits to unions, national associations, employers, and consumer households.
John Boone, president of Comor, also said that Comor expects to sell more than $80 million of NHS products during the next two years. He added that national sales efforts will commence in June 1997.
